exposure: initial diet recommendation (mildly thick or thinner liquids)
cohort: The study included 170 patients with aspiration on VFSS and Type 1 laryngeal cleft seen between January 2012 and March 2024 at a quaternary pediatric hospital.
finding: Patients with pulmonary comorbidities had a more than threefold increased risk of requiring operative management, whereas an initial diet recommendation of mildly thick or thinner liquids significantly lowered this risk.
